summary: Salt Lake City Remodels (slcremodels.com) is a 4.8-star (46 reviews) contractor with claimed Google profile and 96% positive review share. Site audit is Partial (5 pages crawled) due to Lighthouse Failed. Homepage returned HTTP 200 but shows hierarchy/clarity issues flagged as main issue: Homepage H1 count: 2 and Meta description length: 67 characters ('At SLC Remodels it is our goals to make your dreams become reality!'). One broken internal link of 5 checked ( /search 403 ) plus thin supporting pages and no phone/email signal on homepage create straightforward, addressable opportunities.

topOpportunities.title: Fix homepage content hierarchy and heading structure
topOpportunities.evidence: Homepage H1 count: 2 (mainIssue: 'The homepage does not use one clear primary heading.') and Page title: Salt Lake City Remodels
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: A single clear H1 helps visitors and search engines understand the primary offer immediately. Current 2 H1s dilutes focus for a contractor where clarity on services/area matters.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Consolidate homepage to one clear primary H1 that states service + market (e.g., Kitchen & Bath Remodels in Salt Lake City) and demote other headings to H2s. Keep hierarchy consistent on /contact (currently H1Count 1) vs /gallery and /search (H1Count 0).

topOpportunities.title: Strengthen homepage description for clarity (SEO + user)
topOpportunities.evidence: Meta description length: 67 characters and description: 'At SLC Remodels it is our goals to make your dreams become reality!'
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Current description is brief and contains grammatical error ('it is our goals'). A clearer description may improve click-through from search and set expectation before scroll.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Rewrite meta description to 140-160 characters that explains what you do, where, and next step, matching new single H1. Add visible above-the-fold summary to match. Keep canonical true.

topOpportunities.title: Repair single broken internal link
topOpportunities.evidence: Broken internal links: 1 of 5 checked and brokenLinkDetails: https://www.slcremodels.com/search status 403 and Internal links observed on homepage: 5
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: One broken link in a small site (5 links checked across 5 pages) is proportionally large and can frustrate users and waste crawl budget.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Fix or remove link to /search (returns 403). Since crawled /search title: Salt Lake City Remodels / H1Count 0 / wordCount 198 and is likely Squarespace system search, either noindex it and remove from nav/sitemap or ensure it returns 200.

topOpportunities.title: Make contact path obvious and expand lead capture
topOpportunities.evidence: homepageSignals hasPhone: false and hasEmail: false and hasPhone false on homepage with forms 1 and inputCount 1 and No booking or online-estimate signal (Online customer action points 0/10)
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: With 120 images and gallery before/after page (wordCount 250), visitors are likely evaluating work but have limited direct contact signals on homepage, which could add friction to next step.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add persistent phone/email in header/footer, ensure contact page form is fuller than single input, and consider adding 'Request estimate' CTA to match 3 existing CTA phrases. Do not assume current conversion rate.
